name: Translate a short text
short_description: Translate a 500-word non-specialist text between two languages while preserving meaning, register, and unresolved ambiguity.
self_assessment: I can translate a 500-word non-specialist text without help and flag every unresolved ambiguity.
description: Translate a 500-word non-specialist text between two languages while preserving meaning, register, and unresolved ambiguity. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
